newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QNI third qtr production hit by rains.
newsitem.headline: QNI third qtr production hit by rains.

text.p: QNI Ltd said nickel production fell 8.9 percent in the March quarter due to unusually heavy seasonal rains in the state of Queensland and tropical cyclone Justin.

The company said nickel output at its Yubulu refinery in Queensland fell to 5.760 million kg, compared with 6.325 million kg in the March 1996 quarter. Cobalt production fell 19.0 percent to 281,000 kg from 347,000 kg.
Ore grade rose slightly to 1.49 percent for nickel and 0.16 percent for cobalt.
QNI said heavy rains, almost twice the quarterly average, affected both throughput and production.
Cyclone Justin passed over the refinery in late March, causing extensive regional flooding.
Power to the refinery was shut down for the safety of employees and plant, while the flooding increased the moisture content of stockpiled ore, slowing the throughput rate.
Normal operations were resumed by the end of the quarter.
QNI said cobalt production was reduced by the need to establish a working inventory level in the cobalt oxide hydroxide plant, which was commissioned during the quarter.
